dialog.title: Share session
dialog.sessionMode.hint.view: Read only: viewers read files and the session record within the share's scope and can message the session, but every tool runs in a read-only sandbox and no file can be written.
dialog.sessionMode.hint.write: Workspace write: the viewer works in a bounded writable sandbox — it modifies files inside the share’s scope under the writable ceiling; reads and writes beyond that scope are refused, and your global settings, credentials, and other Sessions stay closed.
dialog.allowsFork: Allow viewers to fork the session
dialog.allowsForkHint: Forked sessions keep the same permissions as the source session.
dialog.sessionMode.notGranted: This Harness did not report the session permission back: an older owner build needs an upgrade before the share can carry it.
dialog.permissions.saved: Share permissions and plugin endpoints saved.
dialog.permissions.failed: The share permissions were not saved. Try again.
dialog.permissions.partial: The session permission was updated, but the plugin endpoints were not saved. Try again.
dialog.permissions.modeUnsupported: This Harness did not report a session permission, so it cannot be changed here.
dialog.permissions.discard: Unsaved changes; choosing Done again discards them.
dialog.capabilities.description: Choose one tier for this share; the tier expands at save time into the endpoints the plugins declare now, so endpoints they add later stay closed.
dialog.capabilities.stale: The saved selection is not one whole tier; saving again replaces it with the tier you pick.
dialog.capabilities.noReadable: No plugin offers a read-only endpoint, so Read-only cannot be chosen.
dialog.capabilities.noWritable: No plugin offers a writable endpoint, so Writable cannot be chosen.
dialog.capabilities.writeHint: A writable endpoint takes effect only when the shared Session allows writing, and is destructive inside a writable share.
dialog.capabilities.empty: No plugin currently declares endpoints to share.
dialog.capabilities.createFailed: The share was created, but its plugin endpoints were not saved; retry in Share permissions.
dialog.linkHelp: Closing this panel does not stop the share.
dialog.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select the share link and copy it manually.
dialog.accessUnavailable: Access details for this share are unavailable. Existing permissions are unchanged.
dialog.deploymentAccess: Deployment-authorized identities: {count}. Selection is not the only access rule.
dialog.selectedRetired: This share keeps its older "specific colleagues" scope; new shares offer only the two modes above.
dialog.description: Create a read-only Liveshare link for {title}
dialog.relaySaved: Saved. New shares use this address.
dialog.relayInvalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
dialog.relayReverify: The address changed; sign in again on the new address.
dialog.relayUnsavedHint: This address is not saved yet; save it to put it in force.
dialog.identity.expired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again before creating a share.
dialog.identity.unverified: You are not signed in, so you cannot create a share.
dialog.identity.relayChanged: The current sign-in belongs to another Relay address. Sign in again on this address.
dialog.identity.unknown: Sign-in status is unavailable right now. Try again later; no share is created before you sign in.
dialog.identity.verifyBlocked: Save the address and confirm it answers before signing in.
dialog.identity.loginWaiting: Finish signing in in the window that opened.
dialog.identity.loginDone: Signed in; reading the account state.
dialog.identity.loginCancelled: Sign-in cancelled; no credential was saved.
dialog.identity.loginMismatch: The sign-in answer did not belong to this request and was ignored.
dialog.identity.loginReplayed: This sign-in was already used; start again.
dialog.identity.loginUnavailable: Cannot start sign-in: the Relay is unavailable or this address does not support it.
dialog.identity.loginBlocked: Cannot open the sign-in window (the browser may have blocked it). Allow pop-ups and try again.
dialog.identity.loginFailed: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.
dialog.identity.renewed: Renewed automatically within the granted authorization.
dialog.identity.relayUnsupported: The Relay at this address does not verify identities yet. Upgrade it before creating a share; this page will not create an anonymous one.
dialog.help: Shares this Session only; the session permission decides what the viewer may do, and you can stop it any time in Manage shares.
dialog.mode.open: Anyone in the organization with the link
dialog.hostUnavailable: Cannot reach the DSH Liveshare share service.
dialog.testWarn: Relay HTTP is reachable but registration did not finish and the Host reported no reason. You can still create the share; the gateway retries.
dialog.testFail: Relay connection failed (the Host reported no reason).
dialog.addressHint: Save the share service address first.
dialog.connectivityChecking: Testing whether the share service address answers…
dialog.permissionChecking: Checking whether this host may publish at this address…
dialog.permissionOk: Signed in; this host can publish shares.
dialog.permissionPending: This address must be checked before a share can be created.
dialog.permissionFailed: The permission check did not finish (the Host reported no reason).
dialog.stopFailed: Failed to stop sharing. Try again.
manage.title: Share management
manage.description: View the online state and access scope of every share.
manage.stop.title: Stop sharing?
manage.stop.description: The published link stops working immediately, and anyone viewing it loses access.
manage.stop.acknowledge: I understand the published link stops working immediately
manage.identityExpired: This sign-in has expired, which blocks creating new shares only. The shares published below are unaffected: their links still copy and stay manageable.
manage.unavailable: Could not load shares. Showing the last known state.
manage.historyFailed: Could not load history. Try again.
manage.sessionModeUnsupported: This Harness did not report a session permission, so it cannot be set here.
manage.sessionModeFailed: The session permission was not saved. Try again.
viewer.title: Liveshare read-only session
viewer.readonlyNote: Read only: you can drive this Session, but you read files inside the share’s scope only and modify nothing.
viewer.writeUnavailableNote: The owner granted writing, but this session cannot be driven right now; sending becomes available once it is prepared.
viewer.model.title: The model this Session runs on, chosen by the owner who shared it
viewer.permission.title: The session permission this share carries, set by the owner
viewer.empty: This session has no content to show yet.
viewer.offline: The share is offline. It reconnects automatically.
viewer.expired: This share expired and no longer grants access. Ask the owner to share again.
viewer.revoked: The owner stopped sharing or revoked your access.
viewer.reauthenticate: Your sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
viewer.status.invalid: This link is not valid, or that share was deleted.
viewer.status.invalidHint: Check that the link is complete, or ask the owner for a new one.
viewer.status.offline: The owner is offline right now; this page reconnects automatically.
viewer.status.offlineHint: Wait a moment or choose Retry; if it stays offline, contact the owner.
viewer.status.stoppedHint: Ask the owner to turn it back on if you still need access.
viewer.status.expiredHint: Ask the owner to share the session again.
viewer.status.unavailable: The share service is unavailable right now; retrying.
viewer.status.unavailableHint: Try again shortly; if it stays unavailable, come back later.
viewer.picker.historicalNote: These shares predate verified identities; their access is unchanged.
viewer.relaySilent: liveshare: the Relay answered nothing for {subject}
viewer.unreachable: liveshare: {subject} did not reach the Relay, retrying
viewer.sharePath.unavailable: This page cannot open workspace files: a share hands over file paths, not file contents.
viewer.reason.fork-not-permitted: The owner does not allow branching this Session
viewer.reason.fork-not-implemented: This deployment does not support branching yet
viewer.reason.write-not-implemented: This deployment does not support writing yet
viewer.reason.source-session-mismatch: The branch named a different Session than the share carries
viewer.reason.fork-operation-conflict: This branch request named a different prefix than the earlier one, so no new Session was created
viewer.reason.fork-enforcement-failed: The branch Session was created, but its sandbox limits could not be installed, so it cannot be used
viewer.reason.mode-view: The owner set this share to read only
viewer.reason.unconfirmed: This share’s current state could not be confirmed; it stays read-only until it is
viewer.reason.fork-viewer-unknown: The Relay did not confirm your identity, so the branch cannot be created
viewer.reason.fork-unknown-child: This Session is not a branch of a share
viewer.reason.fork-viewer-mismatch: That branch belongs to another viewer
viewer.reason.fork-source-revoked: The share this branch came from is no longer active
viewer.reason.fork-ceiling-uninstalled: This Host has not installed the read-only execution limits
viewer.reason.fork-prepare-failed: The Host could not prepare this branch, so this action did not run
viewer.reason.share-not-writable: The owner does not allow writing this Session
viewer.reason.source-write-unavailable: This Host could not confine the shared Session, so it cannot drive it
viewer.reason.prompt-identity-missing: This send carried no request identity to attribute, so the Host did not run it
viewer.reason.viewer-not-authorized: Your account no longer has access to this share
viewer.reason.liveshare/read-only: This Session is outside the share you hold, so it was not written
